title.en: AI in Cybersecurity: Governance, Operations, and Auditing
title.zh: 网络安全中的 AI：治理、运营与审计

description.en: Governing, operating and auditing AI services, following the ISACA AAIA pathway: service boundaries, governance and risk; data governance and ethics; lifecycle, change, testing, threats and response; audit planning, sampling, evidence, analytics and reporting.
description.zh: 按 ISACA AAIA 的路线讲怎么治理、运营和审计 AI 服务：服务边界、治理与风险；数据治理与伦理；生命周期、变更、测试、威胁与响应；审计规划、抽样、证据、分析与报告。
